name: elimuar
description: ElimuAR: AR science activities for Tanzanian secondary schools. Web portal, API and the Unity phone app.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@elimuar/api & npm run dev --workspace=@elimuar/web
scripts.mobile:setup: node scripts/unity.mjs -batchmode -nographics -projectPath apps/mobile -buildTarget Android -executeMethod ElimuAR.Editor.ElimuBuild.Setup -logFile apps/mobile/Logs/setup.log -quit
scripts.mobile:build: node scripts/unity.mjs -batchmode -nographics -projectPath apps/mobile -buildTarget Android -executeMethod ElimuAR.Editor.ElimuBuild.BuildAndroid -logFile apps/mobile/Logs/build.log -quit
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@elimuar/shared && npm run build --workspace=@elimuar/api && npm run build --workspace=@elimuar/web
